hippocampus.evidence: Explicit names and existing Phase 0 group only; no ontology IDs/crosswalk rows; head/body/tail are not cellular subfields.

deferredGroupingExamples: Cerebellum: paravermis/lateral hemisphere meshes lack IDs, and only the left vermis is crosswalk-labeled. Do not label the whole cerebellum from this evidence.
Frontal/temporal/parietal lobes: multiple gyri require a reviewed membership map; this allowlist does not claim complete lobe coverage.
Basilar pons: the node name and ontology label (pontine nuclear group) have different granularity; defer a simple whole-pons label.
